A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''commander''' was in charge of [[Desolation Station/Legends|Desolation Station]], a facility that supplied the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] project. When the facility was [[Mission to Desolation Station|destroyed]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] was blamed and [[Death/Legends|executed]] for the incident by the project's overseer, [[X1]].

==Biography==
[[File:X1_questions_the_Imperial_commander.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Imperial commander is brought before X1.]]
A [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of [[Desolation Station/Legends|Desolation Station]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-based facility that produced [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] components for the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="ES DS" /> Between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Dating" /> the last of those components, the [[tributary beam]], was complete and ready to be delivered to the under-construction [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. However, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Mission to Desolation Station|raided]] Desolation Station, with the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X2]] hijacking the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] carrying the part and destroying the facility with the help of the tributary beam. The commander managed to survive Desolation Station's destruction and was brought before [[X1]], X2's brother who was serving the Empire. The captain tried to explain the failure at Desolation Station before being cut off by A1, who ordered the captain's [[Death/Legends|execution]] via [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire by accompanying [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="ES DS" />

==Personality and traits==
Before X1 ordered the captain's execution, the individual tried to make excuses for the failure at Desolation Station.<ref name="ES DS" />

==Equipment==
The captain wore the gray [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]]<ref name="ES DS" /> of an [[Vehicle Command Crewer|Imperial Army pilot]],<ref name="uniform" /> complete with a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="ES DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Desolation Station's commander appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''.<ref name="ES DS" />
